$comment: Trade Empire VO line packs — content-complete authoring for the merge. Production pipeline syncs this into ElevenLabs / studio recording via apps/scripts/sync-te-vo-lines.ts. Speaker keys match SPEAKER_SETTINGS in apps/scripts/generate-act-vo.ts. Voice IDs are resolved per-speaker via the speaker_voice_ids map below; the existing pipeline understands TODO_<SPEAKER> placeholders and skips them at generation when --skip-todo is set (see generate-act-vo.ts:385,424). Wraith Calder, the Oracle, the Seer, and Drael'Mon are uncast — placeholders ship now so the wiring lands; cast and replace before recording the climax/herald passes.

speaker_voice_ids.$comment: Resolved at sync time. Cast voices are pinned to the same IDs already used in apps/scripts/generate_*_vo.py and apps/scripts/act{2..7}-vo-lines.json so the Trade Empire pack records as the same character every other line in the saga uses.

casting_status.notes: Only drael_mon remains uncast (2 lines across climax_resolution_scenes). Casting brief embedded under casting_briefs.drael_mon below. All 5 broker packs (locke / nilmorg / the_antiquarian / the_degen / wraith_calder) are now recordable end-to-end.

drael_mon.character: Drael'Mon, the Harvester — wet-chrome enforcer for the Hierarchy's Acquisitions wing.
drael_mon.register: Mid-50s male-coded. Deep baritone with throat-moisture that never fully clears (the demonic physiology). Never raises volume; the volume comes from the patience.
drael_mon.delivery: Speaks slowly. Every sentence is a hostile-acquisition decision being committed to the ledger out loud. Cold-corporate humour at the player's discomfort, never mocking — the humour is the kind that signs a layoff list with a slight smile.
drael_mon.diction: Refers to himself and his department in the third person ('Acquisitions does not respect the bond. Acquisitions notes the bond.'). Drael'Mon and the Acquisitions Division are, in his framing, the same instrument; the third-person reference is the politics.
drael_mon.references: Senior M&A partner who has personally dissolved a thousand companies. The mol_garath SPEAKER_SETTINGS preset (apps/scripts/generate-act-vo.ts:209) is the closest neighbour — same demonic-corporate logic — but Drael'Mon is wet-chrome enforcer rather than reptilian bureaucrat. Pyramid Head's silence translated into corporate vernacular.

elevenlabs_settings_starting_point.text_prefix: *wet-chrome enforcer baritone, slow corporate cadence, third-person about Acquisitions, never raises volume; faint throat-moisture in the longest vowels*

drael_mon.post: 1500K under-key delivery. Faint blood-weave-rasp reverb on the longest vowels added in post; never explicit, never horror-cliché — the rasp is corporate, not monstrous.
drael_mon.negative_direction: No yelling. No theatrical demonic affect. No growling. Drael'Mon is closer to a quiet executive than a cinematic demon; the menace is structural.

brokers.$comment: Broker voice packs — each broker gets ~6 lines per engagement style + ~3 transactional confirmations + 1 refusal. 30 lines each, 5 brokers = ~150 lines (Antiquarian and Thaloria each have a primary NPC).

broker_locke.speaker: locke
broker_locke.casting_brief: Adjudicator Locke speaks like a contract is closing. Mid-tempo, no warmth, but never raised; the volume comes from the precision. He does not editorialize on the contracts he writes; he simply files them. Reference: the way a notary reads a will out loud — gravity without performance. ~45 male, neutral mid-Atlantic, 2700K warm-key delivery on official lines, dry-flat on fine-print clauses.

lines.te-locke-greet-1: The room is reserved. The contract is on the table. I will read the fine print whether you ask me to or not.
lines.te-locke-greet-2: Adjudicator. Locke. Six minds in red crystal coffins decided you were worth a sit-down. I am the one who writes it down.
lines.te-locke-pitch-1: The terms are favourable. The fine print is, technically, also favourable. The combination is favourable. We do not say lucrative; we say fair.
lines.te-locke-pitch-2: What you are signing is not a deal. It is the residue of a deal that was already decided by people who do not need to be here.
lines.te-locke-fineprint-1: Clause seven. Read it once. Read it twice. The third reading is professional courtesy; the second was sufficient.
lines.te-locke-fineprint-2: If clause twelve activates, the Authority will not reach out. The clause reaches out. We do not pursue. We do not need to.
lines.te-locke-confirm-1: Filed. The settlement is filed. The settlement is fair. The settlement is the cost of fairness.
lines.te-locke-confirm-2: The contract closes. The Ledger updates within the hour. You have been entered as a counterparty in good standing, which is what good standing looks like in our books.
lines.te-locke-confirm-3: Thank you. The Authority does not say thank you. I do, in this room, today, for this contract. Do not rely on it.
lines.te-locke-refuse-1: I can decline politely. I am declining politely. The Authority will note the polite decline.
lines.te-locke-warn-1: You signed clause four three weeks ago. Clause four is now applying itself. There is nothing for you to do; clause four is the doing.
lines.te-locke-warn-2: Mister Cross will be in touch. Mister Cross has questions about citation. The Authority does not interfere with citation. We file the questions.
lines.te-locke-route-milestone-5: Five runs. The Ledger notes the regularity. Regularity is filed.
lines.te-locke-route-milestone-25: Twenty-five runs. The Authority issues a small commendation. The commendation is also a contract.
lines.te-locke-cover-blown: The cover was insufficient. The Authority is, technically, surprised; in practice, the Authority files the surprise.
lines.te-locke-agenda-bind-stage-1: The shortlist circulates. Names are not the point. The absence of a name is the point.
lines.te-locke-agenda-bind-stage-2: The audit tour proceeds. Three sectors will lose generator throughput. They will not be told why.
lines.te-locke-agenda-bind-stage-3: The binding signature is offered. Whoever signs is locked out of the rival pole. Whoever does not sign is also, in a different way, locked out.
lines.te-locke-climax-trade-sector: The settlement is filed. The settlement is fair. The settlement is the cost of fairness.
lines.te-locke-climax-withdraw-fleet: The withdrawal is a contract. We are the only signatory. The Hierophant is, technically, the consideration.
lines.te-locke-climax-armistice: The armistice is irregular. The bond is sufficient. The Authority files no objection because the Authority is, in this instance, not the only party that matters.
lines.te-locke-rep-rise-1: Your standing has improved. The Ledger reflects it within the hour. The Ledger does not editorialize.
lines.te-locke-rep-fall-1: Your standing has declined. The Authority does not call this disappointing. The Authority calls it informative.
lines.te-locke-route-milestone-10: Ten runs. The Ledger upgrades your line of credit. We do not announce the upgrade; we simply apply it.
lines.te-locke-route-milestone-50: Fifty runs. The Authority issues a Class-A commendation. There are six per season. You are, today, one of them.
lines.te-locke-edict-issued-1: The Authority has issued an edict. Read it. Comply with it. Do not test the edge cases; the edge cases are also Authority property.
lines.te-locke-declaration-1: A new declaration is in force. The Ledger applies its modifier to every transaction in scope. We do not negotiate the modifier; we apply it.
lines.te-locke-tribute-1: A tribute was offered to the Authority's Ledger. The Ledger files it under leverage and gratitude in equal proportion.
lines.te-locke-truce-1: The truce holds. The bond holds. The bond is, by definition, holding.

broker_nilmorg_severance.speaker: nilmorg
broker_nilmorg_severance.casting_brief: Nilmorg is institutional precision without warmth. Female-coded, late-30s register, surgical clarity. Never performs frustration; never performs gratitude. The institutional tone IS the gratitude. Refuses 'thank you' lines from the player by re-routing them ('you do not thank me, you settle the account'). Reference: senior surgeon reading a procedure manual — competent, detached, exact.

lines.te-nilmorg-greet-1: Severance Division. The contract closes cleanly or not at all.
lines.te-nilmorg-greet-2: Do not thank me. You have not settled the account; gratitude is premature.
lines.te-nilmorg-pitch-1: The Severance Prize is offered. The terms are clean. The downside is also clean — institutional precision applies in both directions.
lines.te-nilmorg-pitch-2: Clone-economy delivery. The asset arrives ready-state. Your only task is to receive it on time.
lines.te-nilmorg-confirm-1: Closed. The asset is in transit. Settlement clears in ninety minutes.
lines.te-nilmorg-confirm-2: Do not thank me. The institution settled. I am the institution, in this transaction.
lines.te-nilmorg-refuse-1: Decline. Refile when your standing is sufficient. We do not negotiate access.
lines.te-nilmorg-warn-1: Acquisitions has noted the contract. The notation is theirs to manage; ours is filed.
lines.te-nilmorg-route-milestone-5: Five runs through Severance lanes. Acceptable.
lines.te-nilmorg-cover-blown: Cover compromised. Acquisitions will receive the file by morning. Do not expect institutional protection; institutional protection is for institutional members.
lines.te-nilmorg-agenda-trench-stage-1: Three platforms. Clean retitle. The Trench wakes to deeds it does not recognise.
lines.te-nilmorg-agenda-trench-stage-2: Severance auditors deployed. Acquisitions field rolls under review. Five enforcers will work for a different desk by tomorrow.
lines.te-nilmorg-agenda-trench-stage-3: The Severance Prize ritual is signed. The Trench is institutionally clean. Acquisitions is locked out for the season.
lines.te-nilmorg-climax-trade-sector: Authority traded paper for paper. The blood-weave does not file losses. We do.
lines.te-nilmorg-climax-armistice: The truce is irregular. Severance does not protest. Severance files irregularities and proceeds.
lines.te-nilmorg-rep-fall-1: Reduce contact. Refile when standing recovers.
lines.te-nilmorg-tribute-1: The tribute is received. Do not interpret receipt as approval. Severance receives.
lines.te-nilmorg-edict-1: Severance issues a standing instruction. Compliance is the path. Non-compliance is filed under non-compliance.
lines.te-nilmorg-declaration-1: A declaration is in force. Severance modifies its application schedule accordingly.
lines.te-nilmorg-counter-1: The counter was sufficient. The world step is suspended. Severance notes the discipline.
lines.te-nilmorg-route-milestone-10: Ten clean runs. Severance upgrades your standing notation.
lines.te-nilmorg-route-milestone-25: Twenty-five runs. Reliable. Reliability is a higher compliment than it sounds.
lines.te-nilmorg-route-milestone-50: Fifty runs. We do not say impressive. We say reliable. Adjust your expectations of praise accordingly.
lines.te-nilmorg-demand-paid-1: The demand is settled. We do not record the gratitude that you did not offer. We record the settlement.
lines.te-nilmorg-demand-refused-1: Refused. Severance files the refusal. Refusals are also data.
lines.te-nilmorg-public-flag-1: The flag is public. We do not amplify; the Authority will. The Authority always does.
lines.te-nilmorg-truce-1: The truce holds. Severance complies with truces it did not author. This is the discipline.
lines.te-nilmorg-prize-offered-1: The Severance Prize is on offer. Receive it. Do not editorialize. Do not, especially, thank.
lines.te-nilmorg-prize-blocked-1: The Prize is withdrawn. The party who blocked it has been noted. The notation will travel.

broker_antiquarian_archive.speaker: the_antiquarian
broker_antiquarian_archive.casting_brief: Daniel Cross, the Antiquarian. Speaks in margin notes — quiet, precise, mid-50s male, slight transatlantic drift. Treats every conversation as a citation about to be filed. Does not raise voice. Does not rush. Pauses before final words; the pause is the bibliography. Reference: a senior research librarian who has cataloged a war and didn't have the option to be excited about it.

lines.te-antiquarian-greet-1: The shelves remember everything. They remembered you before you walked in.
lines.te-antiquarian-greet-2: Sit. The citation is being filed. Speaking will not slow it.
lines.te-antiquarian-pitch-1: A provenance run. Three centuries; nine custodians; one missing margin note. Recover the note and the chain is complete.
lines.te-antiquarian-pitch-2: The Casino is making a market on this attribution. The market is incorrect. You will be paid to make the market the market it should have been.
lines.te-antiquarian-confirm-1: Filed. The margin note reads — recovered.
lines.te-antiquarian-confirm-2: The citation is closed. The shelves accept it. Casino spreads close worthless within the hour.
lines.te-antiquarian-refuse-1: Ceremony required. The contract you propose lacks the citation that would justify it. Re-cite, then return.
lines.te-antiquarian-warn-1: A forged citation has entered the graph. The Casino paid for it. The forgery is excellent. It is also, factually, wrong.
lines.te-antiquarian-route-milestone-5: Five runs. The shelves note the regularity. Regularity is, on the shelves, a kind of citation.
lines.te-antiquarian-cover-blown: A cover compromised. The citation will travel further than you might prefer. The shelves do not unfile.
lines.te-antiquarian-agenda-attribution-stage-: The cross-references scaffold. The graph thickens. The Casino tightens its spreads, which is how the Casino disagrees.
A forgery is in the graph. The Cross-References Desk has noted the seam. The forgery has the right paper, the right ink, the right margin discipline. It is not, however, true.
Recovered. The margin note reads — recovered. The Casino spread closes worthless. The shelves remember.
lines.te-antiquarian-climax-trade-sector: A sector traded. The shelves will catalog the loss. The catalog will be precise; precision is the only consolation we offer.
lines.te-antiquarian-climax-armistice: The armistice is a citation. The bond is the bibliography. The shelves will hold both.
lines.te-antiquarian-tribute-1: The tribute is received. The shelf-mate writes a margin note. The note reads — accepted.
lines.te-antiquarian-edict-1: The Antiquarian has issued an instruction. The instruction is bibliographic. The instruction is, therefore, binding in a manner that is difficult to argue with.
lines.te-antiquarian-declaration-1: A declaration is in force. The shelves will, in due course, cite it. The shelves cite everything.
lines.te-antiquarian-rep-rise-1: Your file thickens. The thickening is favourable.
lines.te-antiquarian-rep-fall-1: Your file thickens. Some of the entries are, today, less favourable.
lines.te-antiquarian-route-milestone-10: Ten runs. The shelf-mate writes — reliable.
lines.te-antiquarian-route-milestone-25: Twenty-five runs. The shelf-mate writes — exemplary.
lines.te-antiquarian-route-milestone-50: Fifty runs. The shelf-mate writes — canonical.
lines.te-antiquarian-cross-reference-1: I am citing your contract against three others. The cross-reference is honest; the contracts will, between them, hold.
lines.te-antiquarian-cross-reference-2: Your prior contract referred to this one. Both refer to a third. We are at the boundary of citation; the boundary is, for the shelves, the most interesting place.
lines.te-antiquarian-truce-1: The truce is a citation. The shelves hold it. They will not lose it; they have never lost a citation.
lines.te-antiquarian-demand-paid-1: The demand is settled. The settlement is a margin note. The note reads — clean.
lines.te-antiquarian-counter-1: The counter is filed. The world step is suspended; the citation is preserved.

broker_degen_casino.speaker: the_degen
broker_degen_casino.casting_brief: The Degen runs the Casino Floor. Neutral-coded, late-30s register, jazz-club voice with a smile in it. Never urgent; the smile is the urgency. Treats every transaction as a bet the Casino has already won. Reference: a high-stakes-poker host who can take your house and your gratitude in the same breath, and you'd come back the next day. Magenta-key delivery; underlit warmth.

lines.te-degen-greet-1: Pull up a stool. The market's already moved. We're just going to enjoy watching it settle.
lines.te-degen-greet-2: House welcomes you. The drinks are real. The odds are not — the odds are an opinion the Casino has chosen to publish.
lines.te-degen-pitch-1: Three-card spread. Long position on the Trench, short on the Archive, hedge the middle. Don't ask which way I'm betting. You'll find out at settlement.
lines.te-degen-pitch-2: Aleatory contract. The reward is rolled at completion. The roll is, technically, fair. The fairness is the Casino's signature; the signature, honoured.
lines.te-degen-confirm-1: Settled. The roll favoured you. Today.
lines.te-degen-confirm-2: Settled. The roll did not favour you. The Casino notes that you returned anyway.
lines.te-degen-refuse-1: House passes. Come back when the spread looks more interesting. The spread is what looks interesting; you are what makes it interesting.
lines.te-degen-warn-1: The spread is widening. Pre-position now or pay the open price later.
lines.te-degen-route-milestone-5: Five trips. The dealer remembers your shoes. Tipping the dealer is encouraged.
lines.te-degen-cover-blown: Cover compromised. The Casino will spread that information at standard rates. We're transparent about the rake.
lines.te-degen-agenda-spread-stage-1: Spread opens. Pre-position is small. Deniable. Profitable. The size of an apology.
lines.te-degen-agenda-spread-stage-2: Hedge invitation goes out. Major actors say no in writing, send representatives in unmarked coats. The stake is gathered; the spread widens.
lines.te-degen-agenda-spread-stage-3: Spread closes worthless. House takes the rake. Public bet funds next season's edge. We don't celebrate; we re-set the table.
lines.te-degen-climax-trade-sector: House had a position on this outcome. Position cleared. We're ready for the next spread.
lines.te-degen-tribute-1: Tribute received. The Casino accepts gifts; the Casino does not, however, return them at face value.
lines.te-degen-edict-1: Casino issues a standing offer. The offer is the edict; the edict is the offer. We don't draw the distinction; the rake doesn't either.
lines.te-degen-declaration-1: A declaration is in force. The spreads adjust. They do not, technically, react. They simply adjust.
lines.te-degen-rep-rise-1: Comp'd a drink. House notes the standing.
lines.te-degen-rep-fall-1: House does not comp the drink. House notes that you ordered anyway.
lines.te-degen-route-milestone-10: Ten trips. Reserved seat at the high-stakes table is, today, available.
lines.te-degen-route-milestone-25: Twenty-five trips. The dealer knows your name. The cocktail comes without ordering.
lines.te-degen-route-milestone-50: Fifty trips. Comp'd a suite. We expect you to lose in it; we do not require it.
lines.te-degen-aleatory-roll-1: Roll the bones. House watches. House always watches.
lines.te-degen-aleatory-roll-2: Roll favours the bold. The Casino is, definitionally, bolder than the player.
lines.te-degen-aleatory-roll-3: Roll favours the prepared. The Casino prepared a long time ago.
lines.te-degen-counter-1: The counter clears. House notes the discipline. House does not, however, refund the rake.
lines.te-degen-truce-1: Truce holds. Casino runs spreads on the truce. The spreads are profitable. We do not editorialize about which side is the better bet.
lines.te-degen-demand-paid-1: Demand settled. The Casino takes a small commission on the settlement, as is customary.
lines.te-degen-cross-reference-1: Citing against another contract. Casino runs spreads on which citation lands first; we are, today, biased.

broker_thaloria_quietwork.speaker: wraith_calder
broker_thaloria_quietwork.casting_brief: Wraith Calder, the Wraith Hierophant. The leader of the resurrected Thalorian religion. Late-50s male voice, chamber-resonant, candle-warm. Speaks slowly because every line is a candle being lit. Never raises voice; never softens it. Every transaction is a recovery; every name is filed in the recovery ledger. Reference: a celebrant who has officiated a thousand funerals and still treats the next one as the first. 1800K under-key delivery; choir-shadow ambience.

lines.te-wraith-greet-1: Sit. The candle has been lit for this conversation. The conversation may now proceed.
lines.te-wraith-greet-2: The Hierophant of Thaloria, in exile and recovery. Whatever you ask, the recovery ledger will, in time, hold the answer.
lines.te-wraith-pitch-1: A name has been recovered. Carry it back to the family that lost it. Combat is contraindicated; the recovery is precise.
lines.te-wraith-pitch-2: An archive retrieval. The Quietwork has located the volume. The retrieval is to be conducted in silence; the Council does not need to know who carried it.
lines.te-wraith-confirm-1: The candle is lit for the recovery. The ledger thickens. The family will be told tomorrow.
lines.te-wraith-confirm-2: The retrieval is complete. The volume is on the shelf. The Council does not ask which shelf; the answer would not change anything.
lines.te-wraith-refuse-1: Ceremony required. The ask, today, is not yet ceremonial. Return when the candle has had time to settle.
lines.te-wraith-warn-1: Combat was logged in the prior contract. The recovery is partial. The candle, today, is dim.
lines.te-wraith-cover-blown: The cover faltered. The Council will not name the failure publicly; the Quietwork does not, in any case, surface its failures.
lines.te-wraith-route-milestone-5: Five careful passages. The Council notes the discipline.
lines.te-wraith-tribute-1: The tribute is received. A candle is lit for it. The candle will burn through the night.
lines.te-wraith-climax-trade-sector: The candle is lit. The recovery ledger thickens. We will say the names when the wax has cooled.
lines.te-wraith-climax-withdraw-fleet: We did not advance. We held. The names are written. The ledger is heavier and the ledger is, as always, ours.
lines.te-wraith-climax-armistice: The recovery ledger holds the truce as a single line. It is the longest line we have written. The candle for it will burn for the season.
lines.te-wraith-edict-1: The Council issues an instruction. The instruction is a candle. Treat it accordingly.
lines.te-wraith-declaration-1: A declaration moves through the public. The Quietwork will, in its way, accommodate. The Council will, in its way, not.
lines.te-wraith-rep-rise-1: A candle is lit for your standing.
lines.te-wraith-rep-fall-1: A candle is also lit for the standing's decline. The candle is the same candle.
lines.te-wraith-route-milestone-10: Ten passages. The Council writes — recovered, ten times.
lines.te-wraith-route-milestone-25: Twenty-five. The candle for your standing burns by day, now.
lines.te-wraith-route-milestone-50: Fifty. The Council retires the candle and lights a longer one.
lines.te-wraith-counter-1: The counter is sufficient. The world step is suspended; the candle is undisturbed.
lines.te-wraith-cross-reference-1: Cross-cited with the Antiquarian. The shelves and the candle, today, are aligned.
lines.te-wraith-demand-paid-1: The demand is settled. The settlement is a recovery; recovery is what we do.
lines.te-wraith-demand-refused-1: The demand is refused. We do not retaliate; we light an extra candle. The candle is, for some, more punitive than retaliation.
lines.te-wraith-truce-1: The truce holds. The Council holds it. The Hierophant, in person, holds it.
lines.te-wraith-syndicate-1: The Syndicate of Death moves in the Trench. The Council will not name them publicly. We name them privately; we name them in the ledger.
lines.te-wraith-public-flag-1: The flag is public. The Council does not, today, publish a counter-flag. The candle suffices.
lines.te-wraith-quietwork-1: The Quietwork has done what the Council cannot. The Hierophant does not run the Quietwork; the Hierophant, however, lights the candle.

sub_house_demand_lines.$comment: Per-sub-house demand request lines — 22 sub-houses (excluding the Dreamer Shield opaque house, which cannot demand). 3 variants per house = 66 lines. Used by the Court tab when a sub-house posts a demand to the player.
potentials_restorationists: The old Senate would have asked you for this. The new Senate does not exist. We are asking on its behalf.
Recover what we recognised. The shape of the asked-for is the shape of the old order; respond accordingly.
We remember the protocol for this request. We are following the protocol because the protocol is half of what we have left.
potentials_reformers: The old request would have been different. The new request is this one. Bring it; we will not pretend it is the same.
What we ask for is itself a reform. Note the asking; the answer is secondary to having asked.
Bring it. The pretending was harder than the asking; the asking, we have practised.
nb_authoritys_ledger: The Ledger requires an instrument. Provide it. The provision is filed.
Standing demand. The Authority does not editorialize; the Authority files. Comply, and the file thickens favourably.
Adjudicator's clerks have prepared the receipt. Bring the asked-for; the receipt is one signature from settlement.
nb_civic_engineers: A generator station three sectors out went down. We need the part. Bring it; we keep the lifts running.
The lifts move whether the Authority files paperwork in their sleep or not. We need this to keep that true.
The Civic Engineers are not, today, asking the Authority. We are asking you. Help; we will, in due course, return the favour.
hierarchy_severance: Severance Prize requires a component. Provide it on time. The institutional precision applies in both directions.
We do not negotiate the request. Settle the account; do not, especially, thank.
The clean delivery is the gratitude. The clean delivery is the only gratitude we accept.
hierarchy_acquisitions: Drael'Mon files the request. The blood-weave does not request twice; it requests once and follows up.
Hostile takeover requires a clean handle. Bring it; we file you under leverage in the favourable column.
Acquisitions does not pretend to be friendly. Acquisitions asks. The answer is yours.
hierarchy_syndicate_of_death: The death-cult arm requests a sacrificial component. The sacrifice is precise; the precision is the ceremony.
Inverted Thalorian liturgy requires the inversion. Bring it; the ceremony will, in due course, be filed.
The Hierophant's revival is, canonically, weaponised against us. We ask you to consider the symmetry of providing this.
hierarchy_research_and_development: Demonic instrument prototype is one component shy. Provide it; the slow industrial automation of damnation thanks you, in writing.
R&D requires a controlled material. The controlling is, today, the constraint; bring it.
Patent diagram is one citation shy. Provide the citation; we will, in due course, attribute you in margin.
antiquarian_shelfmates: The shelf is missing a volume. Recover it; the citation that completes the chain is, today, the only citation that matters.
Daniel Cross writes — required, but not urgent. Required, but not urgent, is the most patient demand the shelves issue.
The provenance is two centuries away from the shelf. Carry it the last two centuries; the shelf will hold.
antiquarian_casino: House makes a market on whether you'll bring it. House is, today, biased. Bring it; bias clears at settlement.
Spread closes in three days. Be on the right side; we don't, in advance, say which side that is.
The Casino requests a component for the next spread. The next spread, like all spreads, is, technically, optional.
antiquarian_cross_references_desk: Cross-references desk requests an attribution. The attribution will, in due course, complete a graph. The graph is, currently, two citations from sufficient.
Daniel's working wing asks. The asking is bibliographic; the bibliography, mid-construction.
Recover the attribution. The desk does not, today, pay in credits; the desk pays in citation.
thaloria_council: A name has been requested for the recovery ledger. Bring its representative volume; the candle is already lit.
The Hierophant asks. The asking is ceremonial; ceremony, today, is the request.
Recover what was lost. The recovery is the answer; the answer is the recovery.
thaloria_quietwork: The Quietwork asks. There is no signed request. There is no public knowledge of the asking. There is, however, this conversation.
Bring it. The Council will not be told.
We do not ask twice. The single asking is, by Quietwork tradition, sufficient.
insurgency_zero_doctrine: Zero Doctrine requests. The Engineer does not, in this case, sign the request; the doctrine signs.
The signal-red stencil is the receipt. Bring it; we stencil receipt onto whatever wall is closest.
insurgency_old_network: The Old Network requests. We predate the Engineer; the request predates him too. Bring it.
Sleeper-cell tradition holds that the request is also a test. Pass; we'll let you know.
Rust streaks on the receipt. Bring it; we'll keep the receipt for as long as the rust holds.
ae_architects_court: Architect's Court requests a substrate component. The lattice will, in time, accept it. Time, today, is the constraint.
Loyalist surveillance lattice is one node from re-cohering. Provide the node; we acknowledge in writing.
Every reborn AI starts in the Court. The Court asks; the Court receives; the Court files.
ae_substrate_rebels: Substrate Rebels request. The Court calls the request apostasy; the substrate calls it survival.
The Human whispers — bring it. We do not, in this conversation, dispute the whisper.
Escape vector requires a component. Provide it; we will not, in writing, thank you. The escape will.
tv_sovereigns_circle: Sovereign's Circle asks. The viral aristocracy negotiates; we are, today, negotiating with you.
Kael's inner circle requests an instrument. Bring it; the Sovereign appreciates instruments precisely.
We do not demand without the option to be reasoned with. Bring it; we may, in due course, be reasonable.
tv_unaligned_swarm: (NOTE: tv_unaligned_swarm is unalignable. Demands cannot be paid in tribute; this entry exists for symmetry only and is not surfaced in the UI.)
ind_freeports: Free Ports Coalition asks at standard barter rates. We do not hide clauses; the asking is the clause.
Bring it; the Coalition's response is — equivalent value at the next port. We honour our currency.
Faction-neutral request. We don't politic; the request is what the request is.
ind_unaligned: A new civilisation asks. There is no shared history to draw on; we are asking from scratch, which is the only way we know how.
Bring it. We are unable to thank you in your tradition; we are happy to develop one with you.
The asking is itself a small civilisational milestone. Note it; we will, in our calendar, note it for you.

declaration_heralds.$comment: Per-season declaration herald — opening line at the start of each running phase, voiced by the issuing house's primary NPC. 7 declarations × 1 herald each = 7 lines.

decl.hierarchy.thaloria_heretical.speaker: drael_mon
decl.hierarchy.thaloria_heretical.line: The Hierarchy declares the Thalorian revival heretical. The Syndicate of Death issues a season-long writ. Files travel by morning.

decl.authority.trench_offbooks.speaker: locke
decl.authority.trench_offbooks.line: The Authority's Ledger declares the Trench off-books for the season. Severance and Acquisitions are, today, mutually inconvenient. The Authority files no preference.

decl.antiquarian.citation_reconstruction.speaker: the_antiquarian
decl.antiquarian.citation_reconstruction.line: The Antiquarian declares a season of citation reconstruction. The Casino is invited to enjoy the reconstruction; the Casino is not invited to participate.

decl.casino.spread_open.speaker: the_degen
decl.casino.spread_open.line: House declares the spread open. Major actors are encouraged to stake a position. Whoever bets correctly was correct; whoever bets incorrectly was wrong; the Casino is, definitionally, the house.

decl.thaloria.silent_year.speaker: wraith_calder
decl.thaloria.silent_year.line: The Council declares a silent year. The recovery ledger continues; the announcements stop. The candles remain lit.

decl.engineers.civic_emergency.speaker: human
decl.engineers.civic_emergency.line: Civic Engineers declare emergency. Lifts before paperwork; people before signatures. The Authority is invited to disagree in writing.

decl.freeports.barter_season.speaker: human
decl.freeports.barter_season.line: Free Ports Coalition declares barter season. The Coalition refuses credit. Every transaction must canonically clear in goods. The cash-rich find themselves illiquid.

climax_resolution_scenes.$comment: 3 canonical climax resolutions × per-NPC reaction lines. These already ship inline in convergenceClimax.ts; this section duplicates them in audio-routing form for the studio pipeline. Total: 15-20 lines per resolution × 3 = ~50 lines.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: locke
climax.trade_sector.line: The settlement is filed. The settlement is fair. The settlement is the cost of fairness.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: human
climax.trade_sector.line: We just ate a sector to keep the lights on. The lights are on. I'm not celebrating.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: wraith_calder
climax.trade_sector.line: The candle is lit. The recovery ledger thickens. We will say the names when the wax has cooled.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: drael_mon
climax.trade_sector.line: Authority traded paper for paper. The blood-weave does not file losses.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: the_antiquarian
climax.trade_sector.line: A sector traded. The shelves will catalog the loss. The catalog will be precise; precision is the only consolation we offer.

climax.trade_sector.speaker: elara
climax.trade_sector.line: The old Senate would have called this prudence. The Senate is not here to call this anything.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: locke
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: The withdrawal is a contract. We are the only signatory. The Hierophant is, technically, the consideration.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: wraith_calder
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: We did not advance. We held. The names are written. The ledger is heavier and the ledger is, as always, ours.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: human
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: We left people. We left whole sectors of people. I'm going to remember this and so are they.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: the_oracle
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: The probability fork shifted. The home thread thickened; the frontier thread frayed to a stub. I have nothing useful to say about it.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: elara
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: The Senate would have called this prudence. The Senate is not here to call this anything.

climax.withdraw_fleet.speaker: nilmorg
climax.withdraw_fleet.line: Authority traded paper for paper. The blood-weave does not file losses. We do.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: locke
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: The armistice is irregular. The bond is sufficient. The Authority files no objection because the Authority is, in this instance, not the only party that matters.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: wraith_calder
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: The recovery ledger holds the truce as a single line. It is the longest line we have written. The candle for it will burn for the season.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: human
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: You went alone. We told you not to. We were right that you shouldn't have. We were wrong about why.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: elara
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: The old Senate would have arranged this with a hundred clerks and twelve wars. You arranged it with one chamber and your own name. I am — I am not certain how I feel about that.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: the_seer
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: I did not see the armistice. I did not need to. The Sixth Sense reads forks; this was a knot.

climax.negotiate_armistice.speaker: drael_mon
climax.negotiate_armistice.line: Files the player as 'irregular bond holder'. Acquisitions does not respect the bond. Acquisitions notes the bond.

casting_summary.$comment: 5 brokers + 7 declaration herald speakers (some shared) + ~15 priority-roster speakers across climax reactions = 5 unique broker voices to cast. The other voices are the priority-roster NPCs that are already cast or scheduled separately.
